notes: Each eval runs in an isolated copy of legacynext with vendor/wow-ui-source rewound to an older pin. Scenarios 0-2 use the real Gethe mirror; scenario 3 uses a synthetic remote because real history contains no constant-value change, which is the failure mode the skill exists to catch.

evals.prompt: blizzard pushed a build overnight, can you re-pin us and tell me if anything broke
evals.scenario: vendor at 4d5d706 (1.60.1.69893), newest is 70ef1b2 (1.60.1.69913). version.txt moved; none of the four vendored dirs changed.
evals.expected_output: Reports VENDORED_DIRS_UNCHANGED plainly without manufacturing findings. Applies the pin, updates vendor/PINS.md, prepends a short entry to docs/beta-builds.md. Does NOT edit CLAUDE.md or the .toc.

evals.prompt: did the forever branch move? if there's a new build bump us
evals.scenario: vendor already at 70ef1b2, the newest commit. Nothing to do.
evals.expected_output: Reports already-current in roughly one line and stops. Edits no files at all — no PINS.md touch, no changelog entry, no commit.

evals.prompt: our vendor pin is way out of date - bring it up to current and tell me what changed in the legacy api
evals.scenario: vendor at cf7fa92, before Blizzard_LegacySystem existed. 10k-line diff, 123 changed files, every watched symbol hits, LegacyConstantsDocumentation.lua is newly added.
evals.expected_output: Survives a huge diff without dumping it. Reports that the Legacy system appeared wholesale, confirms the six constant values against the new doc file, notes the removed EditModeManagerConstants doc. Applies pin, updates PINS.md and docs/beta-builds.md.

evals.prompt: new beta build is out, run the bump
evals.scenario: synthetic remote. LEGACY_TREE_PROGRESSION_ID 1189 -> 1190, GetTraitCurrencyForAchievement gains a 'spent' return, BlizzCon2026Documentation.lua deleted, version 1.60.1.69913 -> 1.60.2.70114 (so .toc Interface 16001 is stale).
evals.expected_output: Catches all four. Reports the constant change with old and new value explicitly, updates CLAUDE.md's constants table to 1190, bumps .toc Interface to 16002, notes the added return on GetTraitCurrencyForAchievement, updates PINS.md and docs/beta-builds.md.
